title: Multiradial Regular Variation
summary: We introduce and study multiradial regular variation of random fields, allowing componentwise thresholds to diverge at unrelated rates. The limit measures are homogeneous in each component and finite on events where every component exceeds a positive level in absolute value somewhere on a compact window. We characterise convergence by anchor exceedance masses and conditional whole-path laws, together with a compact-window mass bound in the continuous-parameter setting.
